fbd_comment_desc: A note on the diagram; it is not executed
fbd_runs_event: The diagram runs when an input changes
fbd_empty_hint: Drag blocks from the left onto the canvas and connect an output with an input
fbd_no_diagram: This script does not contain a function block diagram
The connection refers to a missing block: The connection refers to a missing block or pin
Types do not match: %s cannot be connect: Types do not match: %s cannot be connected to %s
Input %s is connected more than once: Input %s is connected more than once
Loop without a block that stores a value: Loop without a block that stores a value: %s
Timers need the cyclic mode, in the even: Timers need the cyclic mode, in the event mode they only run when an input changes
fbd_desc_AND: AND: true if all inputs are true
fbd_desc_OR: OR: true if any input is true
fbd_desc_XOR: Exclusive OR: true for an odd number of true inputs
fbd_desc_R_TRIG: Rising edge: true for one cycle when the input becomes true
fbd_desc_F_TRIG: Falling edge: true for one cycle when the input becomes false
fbd_desc_TON: On delay: Q becomes true when IN was true for PT
fbd_desc_TOF: Off delay: Q stays true for PT after IN became false
fbd_desc_TP: Pulse: a rising edge of IN gives a pulse of length PT
fbd_desc_STATE_OUT: Writes an ioBroker state when the value changes
fbd_online_tooltip: Show the values of the running diagram
fbd_online_no_data: No data for %s s - is the script running?
fbd_online_stalled: The diagram does not run anymore (cycle %s)
fbd_online_changed: The diagram was changed - the values belong to the saved one
fbd_online_no_values: Cycle %s - save the diagram once to see its values
fbd_invalid_name: Letters, digits and _ only, not starting with a digit
fbd_no_user_blocks: No own blocks yet - a diagram becomes one with "This diagram is a block" in its settings
fbd_block_hint: A block is placed in other diagrams, as often as needed. Its FB_IN and FB_OUT blocks are its pins; every saved change is a new version.
fbd_block_duplicate: The diagram "%s" defines the same type
fbd_block_update_hint: Takes the new version for all instances in this diagram
Inputs and outputs of a block only work: Inputs and outputs of a block only work in the diagram of a block
A block cannot read or write states - gi: A block cannot read or write states - give it inputs and outputs instead
The pin name %s is used twice: The pin name %s is used twice
fbd_desc_HYST: Two-point switch: Q becomes true when IN rises above HIGH and false when it falls below LOW
fbd_desc_RAMP: Ramp: OUT follows IN, by at most UP per second upwards and DOWN per second downwards (0: no limit)
fbd_desc_PT1: Low pass of the first order (PT1): OUT follows IN with the time constant T
fbd_desc_PID: PID controller: set point SP, process value PV, output Y between YMIN and YMAX; TN or TV 0 leaves that part out
fbd_debug_save_once: Save the diagram once, then breakpoints and single steps work
fbd_debug_breakpoint_hint: The diagram stops in front of this block (F9)
fbd_debug_force_hint: A forced value holds until it is released or the online view ends - and it also reaches the states the diagram writes.
fbd_link_mark_hint: Instead of a line through the diagram, both ends show a mark with a name; a double click jumps to the other end.
The diagram is not shown online: The diagram is not shown online
The diagram was saved before values coul: The diagram was saved before values could be forced - save it once
The diagram was saved before it could st: The diagram was saved before it could stop at blocks - save it once
fbd_instance_open_hint: Shows this instance from inside - online with its own values (double click)
fbd_instance_readonly: Read only: this is the block as this diagram carries it. It is changed in its own diagram. Values can be forced here, breakpoints only in the diagram itself.
fbd_instance_save_once: Save the diagram once, then the values inside the instances appear
fbd_link_refused_type: Not connected: %s does not fit %s (%s). Only INT becomes REAL by itself.
fbd_link_refused_taken: Not connected: %s is connected already - an input takes one link
fbd_no_variables: No states in the diagram yet - they come with STATE_IN and STATE_OUT
fbd_no_favorites: No favorites yet - the star at a block puts it here
fbd_doc_double_click: A double click on an instance of an own block shows it from inside; on a connection mark it jumps to the other end.
fbd_doc_stateful: Remembers its state from one cycle to the next
fbd_doc_time: Depends on time - a diagram with it runs cyclically
fbd_link_refused_const: Not connected: %s feeds inputs already that take no %s (%s)
fbd_state_type_taken: %s reads the state as %s now, as its object says - change it in the properties if needed
fbd_desc_LOG: Writes a line into the log: on a rising edge of TRIG, or when IN changes. %s in the text is the value of IN
fbd_option_edge: on a rising edge of TRIG
fbd_desc_BLINK: Blinker: while EN is true, Q is true for TH and false for TL
fbd_desc_CTU: Up counter: counts the rising edges of CU, R sets CV to 0. Q: CV reached PV
fbd_desc_CTD: Down counter: counts the rising edges of CD down, LD loads PV. Q: CV reached 0
fbd_desc_CTUD: Up/down counter: CU counts up, CD down, R sets 0, LD loads PV. QU: CV reached PV, QD: CV reached 0
fbd_desc_TO_BOOL: Converts to BOOL: 0, empty text and "false" are false
fbd_desc_TO_INT: Converts to INT, rounded; a decimal comma counts as a point, what is no number gives 0
fbd_desc_TO_REAL: Converts to REAL; a decimal comma counts as a point, what is no number gives 0
fbd_desc_TO_TIME: Converts to TIME: a number is ms, a text may be "2s", "1m30s" or "08:30"
fbd_desc_CONCAT: Joins the inputs into one text - round numbers with ROUND before
fbd_desc_CLOCK: The local time: time of day, hour, minute, weekday (1 Monday ... 7 Sunday), day, month and year
fbd_desc_TIMEWINDOW: Time window: true from START to END on the chosen days; a window over midnight belongs to the day it starts
fbd_desc_SCHEDULE: Schedule: Q is true for one cycle when the time of the cron pattern comes
fbd_desc_ASTRO: Sun: Q is true from one event of the sun to another, like from sunset to sunrise; START and END are their times today
fbd_desc_NOTIFY: Sends a notification of ioBroker: on a rising edge of TRIG, or when IN changes. At most 5 a minute
fbd_desc_SENDTO: Sends a message to an adapter like telegram.0 or pushover.0 (text, message, title, subject): on a rising edge of TRIG, or when IN changes. At most 5 a minute
fbd_desc_JS: Own JavaScript: gets IN1 ... INn, dt, firstScan and state (kept between cycles), returns OUT1 or [OUT1, OUT2, ...]
fbd_cron_hint: Minute hour day month weekday, like "0 8 * * 1-5": at 8:00 from Monday to Friday. With seconds in front, "*/5 * * * * *" is every 5 seconds
fbd_code_hint: The code gets %s and returns the value of OUT1, or [OUT1, OUT2, ...]; undefined keeps an output as it is
